task_spec: Add format_order_id(number): our public order IDs are the prefix 'ORD-' followed by the number zero-padded to EXACTLY 8 digits, e.g. order 42 -> 'ORD-00000042'.

bugs.description: format_order_id returns str(number) with no 'ORD-' prefix and no zero-padding, but the spec requires 'ORD-' + the number zero-padded to exactly 8 digits. str(number) is the obvious default; only the arbitrary company ID format in the spec makes it wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary ID format; only in spec
